methods.name: Weighted-BRC recurrent loop-zeta / response / criticality calculus
capabilities: exact rational loop-zeta ratio and symbolic BRC-LN surplus
exact recurrent edge-loop response and response Hessian
rational certificate lower bounds on the critical scale
methods.core_law: Stable finite rational recurrence has Z_loop=det(I-W)^-1, exact edge response R_e=q_e(I-W)^-1_{head,tail}, exact PSD gauge-quotient Hessian, and uniform criticality polynomial p(t)=det(DI-tA).
methods.hard_boundary: Finite positive/non-negative rational recurrence only; no signed/amplitude, complex-log, infinite-state, probability/Fisher interpretation, or canonical rational critical optimizer.

methods.name: Weighted-BRC positive-rational gauge / prime-valuation holonomy calculus
capabilities: finite-support prime valuation coordinates for positive rational weights
unique root/tree spanning-tree rational gauge normal form
unique m-power-free skeleton plus rational m-thickness root
BRC ROOT_m verification/materialization of rational thickness
methods.core_law: Positive rational vertex gauge is integer coboundary addition prime by prime: H^1(G;Q_{>0}^x)=direct_sum_p H^1(G;Z). In a fixed tree normal form every holonomy q decomposes uniquely as s_m(q)t_m(q)^m.
methods.hard_boundary: The log-prime image is not generally a discrete Euclidean lattice; concrete m-power-free tuples depend on cycle basis; C2/mod-m shadows do not determine full positive dynamics; no signed/amplitude holonomy.

methods.name: Weighted-BRC finite explicit cycle-interaction polynomial calculus
capabilities: exact explicit-edge determinant polynomial by disjoint cycle systems
exact rational evaluation and edge partial derivatives
tree-variable elimination to integer-coefficient gauge-coordinate polynomial
finite polynomial numerators for recurrent response
methods.core_law: P_G=det(I-W(x)) is the multiaffine signed sum over vertex-disjoint explicit cycle systems; stable positive recurrence has Z_loop=1/P_G and Gamma=-LN(P_G).
methods.hard_boundary: Enumeration is exponential in explicit edge count; determinant signs are inclusion-exclusion coefficients rather than signed BRC branch weights; no signed/amplitude or complex-weight extension is implied.
